newsitem.title: USA: AgriBioTech to acquire seed company.
newsitem.headline: AgriBioTech to acquire seed company.

text.p: AgriBioTech Inc said Wednesday it agreed to buy a seed company that had sales of about $10 million last year.
AgriBioTech, which made the announcement at the Dain Bosworth "Feed the World" investor conference, did not give the name of the seed company.
Closing of the acquisition is contingent upon satisfaction of contingencies, due diligence and the negotiation of definitive purchase agreements, the company said.
Although there can be no assurances the transaction will close, the company said it negotiated all significant terms and management expects successful closing of the transaction.
AgriBioTech said the acquisition would complement its existing seed operations and will enhance its distribution strength in the forage and turf seed sector.

AgriBioTech, which has completed 13 acquisitions since January 1, 1995, is the largest forage and turf grass seed company in the United States. Its annualized revenues are about $110 million, excluding this pending acquisition and a previously announced $35 million pending acquisition.
